human_substantive_critiques.issue: Discuss the absence of MSP1 expression in the double-knockout lines (PbHscB-PbMei2-dKO and mei2/linup) and its implication for reduced protective blood-stage humoral immunity if a rare breakthrough infection occurs.
Acknowledge the limitation of using a small sample size of mice (n = 6 per group) to rule out rare breakthrough blood-stage infections (citing Kumar et al. 2016).
Quantify mitochondrial colocalization of GFP-tagged PbHscB in Figure 1B using Pearson's correlation coefficient.
Validate liver-stage parasite invasion and development in vivo or in primary/hepatic cell lines rather than relying solely on non-hepatic HeLa cells.
Perform an immunization and infectious sporozoite challenge experiment to demonstrate protective efficacy of the PbHscB-PbMei2-dKO line as a live-attenuated vaccine candidate.

ai_only_critical_catches: Severe pseudoreplication in oocyst and liver-stage size comparisons (Figs 2A, 3A, 4A, and S2A Fig), where Kruskal-Wallis tests were run treating n = 500 individual parasites or n = 240-300 individual oocysts pooled from a single representative experiment as independent biological replicates.

Inappropriate use of a parametric unpaired t-test on binary count proportions of LC3-positive parasites in Fig 2C (n = 200, 107, 137, and 81 pooled parasites across three experiments) instead of a generalized linear mixed model or replicate-level test.

Omission of the actual numerical Pearson correlation (PCC = 0.44) and Manders overlap (MOC = 0.853, 0.894) values from the published Results text and S1D Fig caption despite the authors stating in the rebuttal letter and Methods that they had calculated and added them.

Copy-paste error in the published Fig 4A caption claiming that only WT and PbHscB-KO schizont sizes were imaged when four parasite lines (including PbMei2-KO and PbHscB-PbMei2-dKO) are plotted and analyzed.
Absence of genetic complementation (add-back) or parallel phenotyping of a second independent knockout clone to exclude secondary off-target mutations.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Explain the rationale for using p < 0.10 to screen interaction terms and p < 0.01 for final significance.
Clarify how internal consistency of the 4-item COVID-19 infection worry scale was assessed across the three countries.
Conflation of biological sex mechanisms (hormones, stress axis) with social and cultural gender norms when interpreting cross-country behavioral differences.
Clarify selection criteria and potential selection bias in choosing only Canada, Colombia, and Ireland out of the 42 countries in the iCARE study.
Failure to estimate a pooled multi-country model testing country-level interaction terms rather than running separate country-stratified logistic regressions with vastly different sample sizes.

ai_only_critical_catches: Mathematical impossibilities and corrupted numbers in published Tables 1 and 3: in Table 3 (Colombia), point estimates fall completely outside their own reported confidence intervals for Infection worry on Healthy eating (OR = 1.45, CI = 0.94-1.40) and Psychological distress x sex on Physical activity (OR = 1.78, CI = 0.95-1.46); Wave 3 Alcohol has a decimal typo in the lower bound (.115 instead of 1.15); Table 1 reports Ireland Female 'Clinical anxiety: No' as 1,101 (17.3%) instead of 71.3% and prints the Canada distress t-statistic as '-.21.6*'.

Internal contradiction created during revision where the authors replaced inter-item correlations with Cronbach's alpha values of .86, .81, and .87 but left the text describing them as 'moderate (<.80) internal consistency'.

Inconsistent confidence interval levels (99% CI in main Table 2-4 captions vs. 95% CI in Supporting Information captions) and p < 0.01 significance asterisks placed on intervals (1.01-1.45 and 1.03-1.67 in Table 3) that correspond to p ~ 0.03 under a 95% CI.

Flawed outcome dichotomization that collapses opposite behavioral changes ('favorable changes' and 'no change') into a single reference category, alongside inverted row labels for Alcohol in Table 1 ('Increase/no change' vs. 'Decrease') that contradict the Methods section.

Misinterpretation of the conditional main effect of Sex in regression models containing an uncentered interaction term (Table 2), inverted odds-ratio prose ('decreased their odds of healthy eating by 39%' for OR = 1.39 of eating less healthily), and consistent misspelling of Colombia as 'Columbia' throughout the manuscript.
human_anomaly_details: Reviewer #2 submitted a generic, LLM-style outline of vague writing advice ('a) provide clearer transitions... b) ensure consistent terminology...') with minimal technical engagement, and Reviewer #1 submitted a 4-line superficial note with broken spelling ('1In the abstract , you should provide full nme of COVID19... put variables into the quation').

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Lack of clinical validation for the prostate cancer radiotherapy model (with parameters k_M and C_r chosen by 'clinical experience') and small sample size (n = 10) for the head-and-neck cancer validation cohort.
Omission of Normal Tissue Complication Probability (NTCP) and organ-at-risk toxicity constraints when concluding that SBRT is the optimal treatment regimen.
Simplifying assumptions of homogeneous spherical geometry, uniform cell-cycle radiosensitivity (alpha and alpha/beta) in prostate cancer, and omission of anti-tumor immune responses.
Need for parameter sensitivity analysis and Bland-Altman agreement plots for the clinical validation cohort.
Lack of COMSOL simulation files/code and missing explicit numerical definitions for low vs. high vascular density and modified alpha/beta parameters in the Figure 9-11 legends.

ai_only_critical_catches: Fundamental ODE mass-balance error in Eq. (9) and Eq. (14): the dead-cell accumulation equation dN_n/dt = sum(R_c * c) omits a clearance decay sink (-C_r * N_tot), meaning N_tot monotonically accumulates all cells that have ever died and drives unphysical permanent negative volumetric contraction in Eq. (14).

Biophysically invalid linear Oxygen Enhancement Ratio formula in Eq. (21) (OER = -10 * c_ox + 3), which replaces the saturating Alper-Howard-Flanders hyperbolic relationship and assigns OER = 2.0 at normoxic physiological oxygen concentrations (c_ox = 0.1 mol/m^3 ~ 75 mmHg).

Unphysical initial condition placing 100% of tumor cells synchronously in the G1 phase at t = 0 rather than at the steady-state cell-cycle distribution, plus omission of spatial advection/dilution terms in the point-wise cell-cycle ODEs (Eqs. 1-5).

Severe spatial scale mismatch between the simulated 500 um diameter micro-spheroid (~0.065 mm^3) and the 100-400 mm^3 murine and multi-cm^3 human tumors, where reaction-diffusion oxygen gradients do not scale invariantly.

Continuum fallacy in Fig 8 claiming 'all radiotherapy schemes manage to eliminate all tumor cells' based on linear percentage plots approaching 0%, and a 7-order-of-magnitude unit error in Table 1 listing tumor bulk modulus k as 10.40 x 10^7 kPa (104 GPa, the stiffness of steel).

Decision: Minor Revisions... Technical Soundness and Data Support for Conclusions...') and Reviewer #1 wrote a 3-sentence review while selecting 'I Don't Know' for statistical rigor.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Lack of quantitative mechanical or structural integrity testing comparing native cell sheets and Geltrex/gelatin-modified cell sheets.
Invalid reliance on crystal violet staining as a quantitative measure of cell viability, since crystal violet binds DNA and proteins indiscriminately in both live and dead fixed cells.
Insufficient in vivo tumor characterization relying solely on a single 8-week average diameter without longitudinal growth curves, variance metrics, or tumor take-rate reporting.

ai_only_critical_catches: Triple-confounded in vivo study design: Group B injected 5 x 10^6 bare MDA-MB-231 cells orthotopically into the mammary fat pad, whereas Group C implanted 1.5 x 10^6 MDA-MB-231 cells embedded in a Geltrex/gelatin matrix subcutaneously in the dorsal flank, confounding delivery format with anatomic site, a 3.3-fold cell dose difference, and exogenous basement-membrane matrix co-implantation.

Invalid sample size justification citing an online survey-research margin-of-error calculator ('Creative Research Systems') for population polling to justify n = 3 mice per treatment group (and n = 1 in Group A while contradicting this in Section 2.6 by stating 'three groups, each consisting of 3 mice').

Self-contradictory published revision in Section 3.1 (line 154), where the authors retained the claim '349 vs. 280 viable cells, respectively (P > 0.05)' from crystal violet staining and immediately appended a sentence admitting that crystal violet cannot distinguish live from dead cells.

Unsubstantiated claim of higher liver and spleen metastasis in the subcutaneous cell-sheet group based on single anecdotal H&E images without metastatic incidence tables, lesion counts, or human-specific IHC confirmation.
Internal contradiction in Xylazine anesthetic dosing between Sections 2.6/2.7 (10 mg/kg) and Section 2.6.1 (20 mg/kg).
human_anomaly_details: Reviewer #2 provided a 6-sentence generic praise-only report ('The manuscript is well-written, with a clear structure and logical flow...') that missed every design flaw, while Reviewer #1 raised valid technical objections in Round 1 but accepted the manuscript in Round 2 after the authors declined to add any experimental data.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: The study fails to identify any specific genes, enzymes, or metabolic pathway responsible for coronene degradation despite the manuscript's title and framing.
Table 1 lacked N50 and read quality (Q20/Q30) metrics for the Oxford Nanopore sequencing data.
Clarify the meaning of the 'Total length' column (~1,152,142) in Table 2 across the functional annotation tools.
Lack of wet-lab functional validation (e.g., transcriptomics, metabolomics, or knockouts) to link annotated aromatic-degradation genes to coronene catabolism.

ai_only_critical_catches: Mathematical unit error in Table 2 (introduced in the authors' revision footnote), which falsely states that 'Total length (~1,152,142) refers to the total sequence length (in base pairs) that was processed by each tool', whereas 1,152,142 is actually the sum of translated protein lengths in amino acid residues (~3.46 Mbp of coding DNA in a 3.97 Mbp bacterial genome).

Severe assembly fragmentation (BUSCO completeness of only 81.7% with 11.6% fragmented and 6.7% missing single-copy orthologs) caused by assembling low-accuracy ONT R9.4.1 / Guppy v5.1.13 reads (where only 2.0% of reads reached Q15 and the authors falsely claimed in their rebuttal that Q20/Q30 scores are 'Illumina-specific and not applicable to ONT') using Miniasm + Medaka without short-read polishing.

Bioinformatic artifact reporting 75 eukaryotic retrotransposons (LINEs and SINEs) in a prokaryotic Halomonas genome due to running RepeatMasker with default eukaryotic repeat libraries, paired with a mismatched Fig 5 caption attributing RepeatMasker categories to MobileOG-DB.

Taxonomic reclassification of Halomonas caseinilytica strain 105 to Halomonas elongata based solely on Kraken2 read-level k-mer matching without computing genome-wide Average Nucleotide Identity (ANI), dDDH, or GTDB-Tk phylogenomics.

Unedited internal draft notes left in the published Results text (line 65: '(maybe repot in Mbp or Kbp)'), a logical contradiction in Table 1 ('Number of contigs' expected '<10' vs. 'Contigs > 50 kbp' expected '>10'), and the false claim that 63.04% GC content indicates evolutionary adaptation to high-temperature environments.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: The counterfactual reproduction number R_c(t) assumes linear scaling with the population-average immune fraction phi(t) and ignores age-structured contact heterogeneity.
Clarify the definition of time-varying R_0(t) versus initial R_0 and justify the assumption of negligible immune escape prior to Omicron.
Explain the reconstruction of continuous daily infection curves between serosurvey waves, the waning-immunity decay parameterization, and validation against reinfection/breakthrough data.
Explain how NPI effectiveness psi(t) can take negative values (e.g., during the July 2021 reopening spike).

ai_only_critical_catches: Global proportional sensitivity of the entire NPI effectiveness trajectory 1 - psi(t) = R_t / R_c(t) to the single point-anchored baseline R_0^initial = 2.0 on 1 March 2020 and the fixed 4-day generation interval.

Assumption of statistical independence between vaccination probability and prior natural infection within age strata when estimating hybrid immunity, plus omission of distinct hybrid-immunity waning kinetics.
Underestimation of uncertainty in Table 2 policy-period effectiveness intervals when applying Fieller's theorem to autocorrelated 7-day moving averages across discrete waning scenarios.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Unreliability of manual fluorescence threshold adjustment to suppress DENV-3 to DENV-2 spectral crosstalk in Figure 3, recommending a quantitative Delta-Ct threshold between matched and cross-reacting channels.
Provide inter-assay precision (%CV), LLOD/LLOQ definitions, sample size justification (N = 96), and justify or replace the Chi-square test with Fisher's exact test.
Validate the competition assay progeny using an infectious virus titration assay (FFU/IFA) in addition to qRT-PCR genome copy quantification.

Clarify that the serotype-specific multiplex RT-qPCR assay cannot distinguish competition between genotypes of the same serotype, and include whole-genome phylogenetic characterization of the tested isolates.

ai_only_critical_catches: Statistically invalid application of Fisher's exact test to continuous qRT-PCR concentrations (copies/uL) and mean percentages across n = 3 biological replicates in Figures 4-7 (ironically introduced during revision after Reviewer #4 asked why the Chi-square test was used instead of Fisher's exact test, with both the reviewer and authors failing to recognize that continuous triplicate concentrations are not discrete 2x2 contingency counts).

Direct internal contradiction in the clinical validation section (line 236), which claims 'Therefore, no false positives were detected' in the exact same paragraph that reports 9 routine-negative clinical samples testing positive for DENV-3 and calculates a DENV-3 specificity of 86.95% (60/69).

Post-adsorption inoculum sampling bias in the competition protocol (line 185): sampling the 'inoculum' from the cell supernatant AFTER 2 hours of incubation on HuH7 cells rather than prior to infection confounds the input mixture ratio with differential viral entry/attachment kinetics, explaining why the measured DENV-1:DENV-2 inoculum RNA proportions (14.8% and 9.9% DENV-1 in Fig 4D) deviate sharply from the 33.6% DENV-1 genome-copy ratio implied by Table 1.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Clarify whether Tandem Repeats Finder identified any other repeats in the terminal 24 kb regions and validate the candidate telomeric repeats directly in the raw long reads using TeloSearchLR.
Provide full methodological details for mitochondrial genome assembly, annotation, and tRNA comparison against related Meloidogyne species.

ai_only_critical_catches: Violation of the independent-draws assumption of the hypergeometric test (p = 4.63 x 10^-29) due to spatial clustering of tandemly duplicated effector/CAZyme paralog arrays within individual High Recombination Zones (e.g., 23 PSPs clustered inside a single 340 kb HRZ on Scaffold 3) and double-counting of genes spanning HRZ/LRZ boundaries.

Potential ascertainment bias in change-point boundary precision between High and Low Recombination Zones because recombination markers (eSNPs) were derived from RNA-seq of infected Medicago truncatula root galls and therefore require active gene expression.

Ambiguity regarding whether the 19 rescued small secreted proteins (<66 aa) and 17 BLAST-identified plant peptide mimics (RALFs, IDAs, CEPs) were incorporated into the 1,258 PSP set tested for HRZ enrichment.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Compare H-MAGMA risk gene counts and novel distal loop-linked genes against conventional proximity-based MAGMA.

Explain differences in imputation INFO score thresholds across GWAS cohorts and differences in promoter window definitions between PLAC-seq annotation (2,000 bp) and H-MAGMA (1,500 bp upstream / 500 bp downstream).
Discuss limitations of using pediatric epilepsy surgical resection tissue, European-only GWAS summary statistics, differing GWAS sample sizes, and microglial transcriptional subtype heterogeneity.
Provide genome browser visualizations of representative chromatin loops (e.g., INPP5D, MED12L) and quantify shared versus disease-specific pathways.
Address discrepancies between computational integration frameworks such as sLDSC and H-MAGMA.

ai_only_critical_catches: Mechanistic proof that the manuscript's claim of microglial enrichment for ALS in H-MAGMA (contradicting sLDSC in Fig 1d, which shows zero microglial heritability enrichment for ALS) is an artifact of H-MAGMA combining direct exon/promoter SNPs (124 ALS genes in S4A Fig) with distal loop-linked SNPs (47 ALS genes) and microglia having nearly twice as many called PLAC-seq loops (108,802 vs. 61,895 in oligodendrocytes).

Monte Carlo pseudoreplication in the loop-downsampling analysis (Fig 2b and S4B Fig), where a Kruskal-Wallis / Dunn's test was applied across n = 10 random computational subsamples of the exact same PLAC-seq dataset to report 4- and 5-asterisk p-values (**** / *****).

Severe Linkage Disequilibrium (LD) gene-cluster inflation at the extended MHC locus (6p21: BAG6, NEU1, PRRC2A, PSMB8, PSMB9, TAP1, TAP2, MICB, HSPA1A/B/L, TNF, HLA-DRB1/DRA) and the 17q21.31 MAPT inversion (KANSL1, KANSL1-AS1, ARHGAP27, PLEKHM1), where single LD blocks sharing common SNPs and enhancer loops are counted as 10-15 independent risk genes in downstream GO pathway over-representation tests.

human_substantive_critiques.issue: Overstatement of public health and molecular cluster inference conclusions given that the LANL database sequences represent an unlinked global convenience sample rather than a regional epidemiological transmission cohort.

Strictness of the exact-match cluster criterion in Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI), motivating sensitivity analyses with >50% and >66% overlap coefficients and higher wgs proportions (wgs95, wgs99).
Clarify how IQ-TREE treats missing characters/gaps in likelihood calculations and why Robinson-Foulds distance variance increases at high wgs proportions.

ai_only_critical_catches: Pinpointed the exact phylogenetic and statistical mechanisms causing the non-monotonic 'T-shaped alignment' degradation at 10-40% wgs that the authors and human reviewers left unexplained: (1) fitting an unpartitioned single-matrix GTR+F+I+G4 model across conserved pol and faster-evolving env/gag regions distorts branch-length scaling between pol-only tips and wgs tips (explaining why 64% of clustered sequences at wgs50 are pol-only and why midpoint rooting shifts), and (2) unstratified bootstrap column resampling across a ~9 kb alignment where ~85% of sites are gaps for pol-only sequences dilutes the effective sampling of informative PRRT columns relative to a trimmed 1.3 kb pol alignment (wgs0), directly explaining the cliff-like drop in >=90% bootstrap clusters between wgs0 and wgs10-50 in Fig 6A.

Omission of any pairwise genetic distance or patristic branch-length cutoff in cluster definition (relying solely on bootstrap support >=70-99%), which groups deep historical subtype B clades rather than acute epidemiological transmission clusters.

Unadjusted multiple one-tailed t-tests across mixture levels and omission of the IQ-TREE software version, bootstrap algorithm flag (standard non-parametric -b vs. Ultrafast Bootstrap -B), and HXB2 coordinate boundaries.
